_what: The five reference rates, re-derived against WALL TIME. Supersedes the 861.6s figures.
_the_seam: THE 294 BEATS ARE TWO ANNOTATORS, NOT TWO READINGS, AND THEIR VOCABULARIES DO NOT OVERLAP AT ALL. Pass A uses 60 distinct treatment terms, pass B uses 31, and the intersection is ZERO. Two of A's terms are Title-Case; thirty of B's thirty-one are. They are different annotation systems applied to the same ten videos.
_why_one_set_is_not_publishable: NEITHER PASS COVERS ALL FIVE FAMILIES. Pass A names no SFX treatment at all (0 of 155 beats); pass B names no zoom treatment at all (0 of 139). So the five-family table was only ever completable by AVERAGING ACROSS THE SEAM: last night's 'sfx 1.31/25s' is the mean of 0.00 and 2.64, and 'zoom 0.23' is the mean of 0.47 and 0.00. Those are not rates; they are artefacts of averaging an annotator who names a family with one who does not. Zac asked for one set with provenance — the honest answer is that one set does not exist until a canonical annotator is chosen or the two vocabularies are mapped onto each other, and this file is that answer.
_absent_is_not_zero: A family a pass never names is ABSENT, written null, never 0.00. A rate of zero says the annotator looked and found none; null says the vocabulary had no word for it.

_superseded.against: 861.6s, described as beat span across 294 beats
_superseded.wrong_how: 861.6s is BOTH passes summed — twice the footage — and the five numbers are cross-annotator means, two of which average a real rate with a vocabulary gap

_provenance: MODEL-ANNOTATED readings of ten videos, 426.093s of wall time from ChatCut project 74036980; counts are treatment labels a model assigned, not mechanical counts; the rates GRADE and never instruct.
_one_table: This file is the ONLY reference table. The function that summed both passes is deleted, not kept beside it — a second way to compute a number is how the wrong one gets quoted, and the wrong one here averaged a real rate with a vocabulary gap. The beats TILE their videos (pass B joins the ten durations as a bijection, max residual 0.013s), which is what settles the denominator at wall time.
